limits: Status is latched; sampled high is not a fresh completion. Existing two-frame guard remains unchanged.
routing_limitation: Two SSPP source halves do not by themselves establish two output pingpong engines. PP0/PP1 bits are observed as candidates; actual INTF_MUX/merge route is not qualified by D17.

native_read_semantics.status_read: sde_hw_intr_get_interrupt_status reads status then optionally writes separate clear address only if clear=true
native_read_semantics.dispatcher: reads status and enable; writes clear then dispatches only enabled bits
native_read_semantics.freshness_requirement: A high latched bit without a known clearing boundary cannot identify completion of the new commit
